conflicts.permit: If a Kid e-mails a question to Hugs N Hearts, using the “Ask a Question” or “Support” type of a feature which may be available within the Kids Apps, Hugs N Hearts may respond to such question by using the Kid’s e-mail address.
conflicts.prohibit: Hugs N Hearts does not collect and does not permit Third Parties to collect from Kids any information that may personally identify an individual (e.g.name, address, e-mail) (other than the Kids’ Persistent Device Identifier which is collected for the limited purpose of supporting the internal operations of the Kids Apps) and any other personally identifiable information of a private and/or sensitive nature about the Kids.
conflicts.situation: When a child under 13 uses the 'Ask a Question' or 'Support' feature within the Kids Apps and sends an email to Hugs N Hearts.
conflicts.reason: Section 3.2 broadly states the company does not collect personally identifying information such as email (except device identifiers), directly contradicting Section 3.3 permitting email collection.
